method: Offline CUE4Parse extraction (read-only) of the same 1098 selected gameplay packages, the archived .ini files, the English localization, the string tables and the asset registry; byte-for-byte SHA-256 comparison against the extraction of 25647873.
path_comparison: case-insensitive (Unreal paths are); ~3.1 thousand files only changed the letter case of a folder or file name, e.g. DiveBar -> DIVEBAR

files_with_a_different_size.note: Almost all are re-cooked meshes, materials, animations and levels.

identical: all item/skill/upgrade definitions, collectible definitions, quest and mission assets, save classes in the selected set
conclusion: Gameplay data used by the catalog (tags, items, locations, save-variable schema) is unchanged. The update touches combat and boss behaviour (GA_AttackBase, GA_BasicAttack_DodgeFollowup, GA_CounterAttack, Dancer PantherEyes, GA_GameplaySegment_Base, input mapping, a new GE_DamageImmune effect) and re-cooks many levels. No catalog change is required.
not_established: Static comparison only. UE4SS signature scanning and the bridge behaviour on the new executable, and any interaction of the new GE_DamageImmune effect with Half Heart/DeathLink, are confirmed only by running the game (see docs/DEVELOPMENT.md).
